Masks and silence

Lore

Sleep Token are an anonymous British collective. The members conceal their identities behind masks and are known as Vessel, II, III and IV.

The music is framed as worship of an entity called Sleep: albums become offerings, live shows become rituals, and messages are sometimes written in a dedicated alphabet.

The sound moves freely through heavy alternative music, soul, ambient textures and pop melody. Anything beyond official statements remains listener interpretation.

Live shows are staged as candle-lit ceremonies with the vocal ensemble Espera, and the project famously gives no interviews — the silence itself is part of the worship.

Timeline of the Ritual

  1. 2016Debut EP One quietly introduces the worship concept.
  2. 2017EP Two expands the mythology and the masked identity.
  3. 2019Sundowning arrives track by track, each released at sundown.
  4. 2021This Place Will Become Your Tomb deepens the atmosphere.
  5. 2023Take Me Back To Eden; “The Summoning” goes viral; Wembley Arena sells out.
  6. 2025Even In Arcadia debuts at the top of the charts; Download Festival headline.
